name: Thonglor Pet Hospital Pattaya
addressFull: 147/41-44 Moo 9, Sukhumvit Road, Nong Prue, Bang Lamung, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand
afterHours: Emergency cases are accepted without an appointment at all hours.

emergency.notes: The Pattaya branch directly states that it is open 24 hours and accepts emergency cases without an appointment. Its branch page also states that veterinarians and nurses provide round-the-clock inpatient monitoring, which is direct evidence of overnight clinical staffing. No separate after-hours number or surcharge was published.

petTravel.notes: The Pattaya branch advertises international pet relocation. The group service confirms ISO-compliant microchipping, FAVN rabies-titre testing through accredited international laboratories, international health certificates, and documentation/logistics management. A Pattaya-branch DLD licence number and the exact division of work between Pattaya and the central relocation team were not published; final Thai government endorsement remains a DLD function.

complaints: some reviewers describe higher costs than local clinics
